auth.onboardingIntro: Connect your Telegram account to publish stories straight from your browser.
auth.qrInstructions: Open Telegram on your phone, go to Settings → Devices → Link Desktop Device, then point your camera at this code.

story.caption: Caption
story.dragDropHint: or drag and drop it here
story.noChannels: No channels or groups found where you can post stories.
story.selectAtLeastOneTarget: Choose at least one place to post to.

errors.storiesTooMuch: You've reached Telegram's active Story limit.
errors.phoneNumberInvalid: That phone number doesn't look right.
errors.phoneCodeExpired: This code has expired. Request a new one.
errors.fileTooLarge: This file is too large to upload.
errors.floodWait_one: You can try again in {{count}} second.
errors.floodWait_other: You can try again in {{count}} seconds.
errors.loadAccountInfoFailed: Couldn't check your account details — captions and story duration options may be off until this loads.
errors.loadChannelsFailed: Couldn't load your channels and groups — only your personal story is available right now.
errors.missingApiCredentials: No Telegram API credentials are set up yet. Add your own below, or (for local builds) set VITE_TELEGRAM_API_ID/VITE_TELEGRAM_API_HASH in .env.local and rebuild.
errors.connectionTimeout: Couldn't reach Telegram's servers in time. Check your connection and try again.

schedule.publishAtHint: Posted automatically at this time — you don't need the extension open.
schedule.mustBeFuture: Pick a time at least a minute from now.
schedule.needsLoginTitle: {{count}} scheduled stories need you to log in
schedule.needsLoginBody: Your Telegram session expired, so these can't publish automatically until you log in again.
schedule.needsExtensionContext: Scheduling only works when this is loaded as a real extension (chrome://extensions), not when running as a plain dev-server tab.

apiCredentials.title: API connection
apiCredentials.usingDefault: Using the app's shared default credentials.
apiCredentials.logoutWarning: Saving this logs you out — you'll need to log in again under the new credentials.
apiCredentials.invalidId: api_id should be just the number from my.telegram.org/apps.
apiCredentials.invalidHash: api_hash should be the 32-character code from my.telegram.org/apps.
